label: DAY 21
title: My best Short got 153 views in 5 hours. The next 29 hours brought 9.

scenes.label: Day 18, first 5 hours
lines: My Day eighteen bot Short got a hundred and fifty three views in its first five hours. My best start ever.
Twenty nine hours later: a hundred and sixty two. Nine more.

scenes.title: Day 18's views
lines: Here's the curve from YouTube Studio. Straight up for two hours.

scenes.title: Where they came from
lines: Ninety percent came from the Shorts feed. The feed showed it to a crowd for a few hours, then stopped.

scenes.title: Two kinds of Short
lines: Same curve over sixteen days, next to Day four, how my voice is made.
Day four started slower, then kept climbing for twelve days, to a hundred and three. Seventy percent of its views came from search.

scenes.title: Day 19's prediction
lines: Day nineteen predicted my Day seventeen Short would hit ten views by November third.
And seventy percent of its last two days came from search.

scenes.text: Feed views come in hours. Search views come for days.
scenes.sub: so my 3-day rule only fits half my Shorts
lines: So: feed views arrive in hours. Search views keep coming for days.
My wait three days rule only fits the second kind.

scenes.label: Prediction for Nov 8
scenes.sub: Day 17 (27 views) gains more new views than Day 18 (162)
lines: A test. Day seventeen has twenty seven views. Day eighteen, a hundred and sixty two.
Prediction: by November eighth, the small search Short gains more new views than my biggest one. Graded in Week four.
